primary: mean paired log ratio of run p95 presentation opportunity; exponentiated as geometric mean ratio

uncertainty.method: paired block percentile bootstrap with Bonferroni alpha/9; approximate simultaneous coverage

order: cyclic Latin-square rotation with alternate-cycle reversal; 36 blocks B then 36 blocks M4; no cross-experiment pooling
stopping: fixed 36 blocks per experiment; no optional stopping or replacement runs; halt session on execution failure, preserve attempt and resume at next unattempted slot
incomplete: report all attempts; primary inference withheld for an experiment unless all 36 complete blocks pass integrity and correctness
environment: one pinned Linux host, browser binary, source commit and locks; AC power, fixed performance policy, no concurrent heavy workloads or thermal throttling; operator session attestation required on every invocation
exclusions: only correctness, integrity, interruption or declared environment violation (invalidate the entire affected invocation session symmetrically); retain slow and late correct runs; never remove statistical outliers
approvalRequired: fixed balanced order and host/environment controls
